fields.statement: At e8e4de61 ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-disk-low|daemon-picks)$' -count=1: both PASS. inbox-disk-low.txtar puts a daemon state with disk_low (1 GiB free, 10 GiB min) and rhiza inbox --json shows exactly one "kind": "disk-low" item naming '1.0 GiB free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB'; after a later state without disk_low it shows none (items []). daemon-picks.txtar shows the same through real daemon polls (RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES low, then 20 GiB clears it). go test ./internal/tui/inboxapp -run DiskLow PASS (app groups it under 'Disk space'). make test, fmt-check, vet pass; make self-check passes with RHIZA_ROOT unset. Read the diff: daemon sets/clears State.DiskLow per successful poll and keeps Since across polls; inbox open refuses the item.
